definitions.meaning: A trick that causes damage or loss

quotations.old_english: Lá, hwí ne mót ic habban þæt ic mé sylf beget mid mínum lyrewrencum ?

source_text: lyre-wrenc, es; m. A trick that causes damage or loss :-- Lá, hwí ne mót ic habban þæt ic mé sylf beget mid mínum lyrewrencum ?, Verc. Först. 168.
